authentic.title: Genuine product
authentic.scannedBefore: This code has been scanned before. If you just bought this item, that can be normal (retail checks), but stay alert.

already_verified.title: Already verified
already_verified.body: This code was first verified on {date}. If that wasn't you, the product may not be original — contact the brand.

inactive.title: Not yet activated
inactive.body: This code exists but has not been activated by the manufacturer. The product may not have left the factory through official channels.

flagged.title: Warning
flagged.body: The brand has flagged this item. Please contact the brand before purchasing or using it.
flagged.stolen: This item was reported stolen by the brand. Please contact the brand.

invalid.title: Invalid code
invalid.body: This code could not be verified. The product may be counterfeit.

scratch.title: Confirm with the hidden code
scratch.hint: Scratch the coating on the label and enter the hidden code to complete one-time verification.
scratch.verified: Hidden code confirmed — this item is verified as genuine.
scratch.already: This hidden code was already used on {date}. If that wasn't you, contact the brand.
scratch.invalid: Wrong hidden code. Check the characters and try again.
scratch.locked: Too many attempts for this serial. Try again later.
